messages.content: Read the customer messages in chronological order. Record the latest cancellation intent using one native update_cancel_goal call. Later corrections override earlier scope. Identity or reason answers do not cancel an earlier request. For all_pending or none use an empty order_indices list. For selected use zero-based indices from candidate_orders. source_message_index must identify the customer message establishing the latest scope. Never output plain text.

function.name: update_cancel_goal
function.description: Record the current requested cancellation scope. This does not cancel or authorize anything. Use none when cancellation is withdrawn or not requested.
